registry_scope: Public GitHub HEAD trees for every site named in the user-supplied 126-row ledger, plus 13 pinned witnesses. Not an organizer-complete registry: renamed, private, external, unlinked, deleted or later-written rasters may be absent. A HEAD snapshot is not a pinned commit for unpinned rows.

literal_reading.note: Literal reading fires on space-filling controls / continuous prior for ANY nonempty candidate; reported, not silently exempted.

like_for_like_reading.note: Inherited thresholds applied to geological dot fields; rank correlation applied to every raster including continuous surfaces and controls.

format.reference_provenance: Hash-pinned third-party mirror; not organizer authenticated

exploratory_projection_not_score.method: Historical focus rasters evaluated on the SAME folds; user-reported claims (NOT organizer receipts) within +/-0.03 holdout DTI of this candidate define a bracket. No calibrated leaderboard forecast exists.
exploratory_projection_not_score.note: A projection is never a score. Public/private truth and receipts are unavailable.
